name: Morphia Halmshaw
original_name: モーフィア・ハルムショー
source:
[i]"My love for you was never a lie."[/i]

[i]Loving Maternal[/i]

Tilkett's older sister. A gentle and warm woman who loved children. Though she was a bit of a klutz and an airhead, she was a talented lawyer beloved by many. She was also a philanthropist who used much of her remuneration to aid children in need.

A few years ago, she was killed by an unknown assailant. Tilkett suspects her killer is a member of Vy-xen.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/kaleido/english/characters/?page=morphia]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
